guard_summary.inspection_retry_boundary: AccessDenied uses a 200 ms environ retry admission window and 21-attempt cap, or three attempts for other operations; only the exact proc_environ SystemError raised by the requested environ operation shares that policy; individual OS calls are not forcibly timed; all pauses count and RSS/deadline checks remain mandatory after inspection; only independently confirmed gone/zombie or changed birth is skipped; persistent live or unknown failure fails closed
guard_summary.cleanup_boundary: owned group, observed descendants, and inherited marker with three empty sweeps spanning50ms; trusted toolchain must preserve marker; polling is not atomic or hostile-process containment
guard_summary.rss_scope: live union of current ancestry, retained PID/birth identities and periodic inherited-marker matches; sampled, not a kernel quota
